description: Package-agnostic reversible secret storage -- for values a caller must later recover in plaintext (e.g. a third-party IMAP/SMTP password), unlike Credential which only ever verifies a one-way hash and never returns it. Plaintext only ever leaves DBAL via POST .../EncryptedSecret/{id}/reveal (see encrypted_secret_route_handler.cpp) -- normal reads never expose ciphertext or nonce.

id.description: Unique secret ID, referenced by FK from the owning entity (e.g. EmailClient.credentialId)

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM body || 16-byte auth tag, base64. Never returned in queries.

nonce.description: 12-byte AES-GCM nonce, base64. Never returned in queries.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp (ms) -- bumped on rotation
